cues.text: In a back alley, Shinjiro sits hunched on a flight of stairs, a hand pressed to his chest. A young couple stands nearby.
A young man with long hair and a bare, tattooed chest walks up, followed by a boy with glasses carrying a metal case and a girl in a long, frilled dress.
The couple hurries off down the alley.
The boy with glasses tosses the capsules to Shinjiro, who catches them.
The three turn and walk away, leaving Shinjiro standing alone.
